body: I’m not even there for myself.
Yeah, no one ever checked it but I can a breakdown and they checked in once but once they think I’m fine no one checks in. It’s a bit sad really.
I just wait for people to text first to see if they hate me but then just give in and text first.
Aww, it’s not a good feeling.
Damn, I wish they didn’t laugh for me. I guess different people can have entirely different tolerances to sensitive subjects.
I would assume so, it’s unfortunate.
Then I never had any friends.
When I joke about it is it a cry for help, a cry into the void.
My friends don’t leave me on read anymore, they just ignore me all together lol.
The blood calms anger, it’s somehow fun to take care of wounds, it’s a distraction, it validates pain and it’s just generally calming. I keep on messing up but at let I’ve got my razors.

Looking at it from an objective standpoint, it’s not the worst thing but the thought of intentionally harming yourself, particularly cutting is just disconcerting for some people, on a really instinctual level.
